_doc: #1786 THE HOMEPAGE BOXES of Capital-Stack-FinTerminal: a Homepage card that lists its page's instruments instead of a one-line description. `quote_boxes` (by sub-page id): the box shows the `top` first instruments with the declared `columns` (`last` = the delayed last price, a period id = its change in % from the quote source of data/quotes.json; the long periods are Cagr.kt's) and a Show all toggle that lists every instrument in place; a tap on the box's header opens the page. A box names its instruments ONCE, where the page already declares them: `from` = `futures:<class>` (data/quotes.json futures class fronts), `fx` (data/quotes.json fx currencies), `commodities` (data/quotes.json commodities fronts) or `dashboard:<id>[/<panel>]` (data/dashboards.json fetch.each and labels of the dashboard's performance / quote panels); `items` lists them only where no page declares them. `order` puts the named symbols first (the major economies of a world index box). `cb_boxes`: the CB Homepage overview, one box per indicator group, each row a country of data/cb-countries.json with the latest print of each column's indicator from data/cb-snapshot.json (the year in progress to date when the source is sub-annual, else the last annual actual; `mode` fc0 = the current-year forecast); the `top` countries first, Show all lists every country. Nothing here is a figure: a missing value is n/a.

world-equity-indices.note: the major economies first: US, China, euro area, Japan, UK

hedge-calculator.note: the equity index futures the calculator sizes a hedge with

onshore-usd-rates.note: the Treasury yield indices of the quote source (the page's own panels are NY Fed and FRED rates)

_doc_cb_top: the major economies first (US, euro area, UK, Japan, China, then Germany); the box shows the first `top` of them, Show all every country of the snapshot.

ui.cb_note: Latest print: the year to date where the source is monthly or daily, else the last annual actual; Fcst = the current-year forecast (IMF / OECD). Yield curves: GB, JP and CN read the FinTerm API sovereign curves live (the day and publisher under each value), else the snapshot.
ui.live_off_mesh: live curves not reachable (off the mesh): snapshot shown
ui.live_no_answer: live curves: no answer from the FinTerm API: snapshot shown
